verdict.rationale: The pricing page is the only first-party mention of concurrency or queueing: the Fancy plan lists "Unlimited parallel generations" and "Priority queue". The API is mentioned, but nothing documents concrete limits or queue behavior for programmatic batch rendering. missing for 10: per-plan concurrency numbers for lower tiers, API rate and concurrency limits, documented queue semantics (ordering, wait times, retries, timeouts), batch-rendering guidance, independent corroboration.
